extraction.Name: Frances Dubray (deceased)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Walcott and Walcott January 31, 1919
extraction.Buyer: The land was mortgaged on January 28, 1919, to Walcott and Quigley for $600, and again on April 26, 1919, to Walcott and Walcott for $100, and deed from Frances Dubray Eastman and husband dated August 6, 1920, conveyed the land to Emery Rusho for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent no. 612445 issued; North half of Southeast quarter section 29, township 38, north of range 26; receipt for patent signed by allottee January 21, 1918; allottee is deceased; also appears as Frances Dubray Eastman
